text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Heroes' welcome to Arab champions (Jordanian team that won soccer gold cup at Pan-Arab games).

- Statement by Islamic Action Front says decision to boycott parliamentary elections "is not irreversible and subject to review"; leftist secular opposition fail to come out with united position on whether to boycott November elections.
- King Hussein fetes Jordan's sporting heroes.
- Israeli Foreign Minister Levy visits Jordan on Tuesday to hold talks with king and senior officials.
- Interior minister says there are no signs Islamists have split over internal differences on boycott of parliamentary elections.
- Crown Prince Hassan asks Foreign Ministry to work on reactivating joint Arab action.
- Jordan buries pilot who crashed at airshow in Belgium.
